metadata.coldDefinition: First preparation of each case in the recorded order after clearing only wardrobeFitCache; existing module/source caches remain in-process and may perform first-use setup.
metadata.warmDefinition: Immediate repeat of the preceding cold look; all existing caches remain available.
metadata.scope: Untimed, instrumented Node CPU work counts; copy bytes are cumulative traffic, not retained/peak memory. Exact duplicate keys distinguish signed zero, exclude nonfinite/unsupported input getters, and are scoped to each warp closure; bounded tracking flags truncation. Repeatable rays are potential avoided work, not measured time savings. No GPU/FPS claims.
metadata.sourceHashScope: Individually hashes transformed counting modules; HEAD identifies other runtime code. Asset hashes identify full loaded GLB files; the CPU loader excludes texture decoding.
metadata.fixtureScope: The accepted garage fixtures explicitly use garage base actors; normal desktop GarageDriver uses a portrait base actor with garage garment/corset tiers. These fixture timings/counts are not a browser-route benchmark. The optional default desktop case is separately resolved through the current production resolver.
